notes.title: Steam Playtest Now Open!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333998/4a4937888a3553523aedf5980772e676fa238945.png[/img]

[h3]🎁Merry Swapmas! Momo Claus has a gift for everyone! 🎁[/h3]
[h2][b]Starting now till January 13th a public playtest build is available on Steam![/b][/h2]
[h3]To sign-up and get access there is a button on the Steam page. 
Sign-up ends January 6th 11:59 CT. [/h3]

There are a lot of updates in this build. We've been re-creating most of the game to run smoother for features we want in the future, and this is that new version! We would really appreciate any feedback, and are super excited to share this update with you all! ♥ ♥ ♥

You can post your feedback in our official discord server [url=discord.gg/SwapetteShowdown]discord.gg/SwapetteShowdown[/url]
Or you can share your feedback via this [url=https://forms.gle/G7iGdKRpk5a6GCA19]google form[/url] 

Updates from the previous demo:
- New Versus mode with different game modes to choose from.  
- The board has customizable settings, see the options in Character Select
- New AI 
- New Menus
- New Character Select
- Character special updates
- New controls remap system 
- The replay system is not stable currently so it may not work in this version
- The board visual accessibility options are in the character select, options menu > display settings menu
- There is no Campaign mode in this build, for now we want our testers to focus on the Versus mode

Have fun! 

[b]Love, 
The Swap Fam[/b]💖

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
🎄🎁❄ ~ Merry Swapmas ~ ❄🎁🎄

notes.title: Alpha 2.2.0 Update Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333998/3080d5d68e8d0519037a599914ca75a58e0e408f.png[/img]

[b] Alpha 2.2.0 Patch Notes[/b] 💖
- Updated countdown audio in story mode 
- Containerized and cleaned up block state management 
- Cleaned up board initialization and block instantiation 
- Resolved swap inconsistencies 
- Swaps now run more efficiently
- Removed block reset hack 
- Tera’s sprite updated
- Queen Polleen was named 
- 2x2 cursor can now partial swap if one block is immoveable (Era) 

[b]Known Bugs[/b] 🐛
- Disconnected chains
- Polleen’s special freezes transforming garbage when special activated during a match
- Blocks getting stuck when falling 
- Era's cursor swap 1 and 2 buttons have been swapped
- Resolution has unexpected sizes whenever you go to the main menu... Can still be fixed with the in-game settings

[b]Bonus[/b] 🍭
- AI was accidentally given sugar

notes.title: New Swapette & Other Updates!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33333998/991368aa8a35bc48675ba31fb040e4cbe9cc924a.png[/img]

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
[h1]Change Log for - Buzz Buzz Update (Alpha 2.0.0)[/h1]
[b]General Gameplay and Balances:[/b]
[list][*] All six Alpha characters are now available.
[*] The 1x1 block in 4 player has been removed, and replaced by 1x2.[/list]

[b]Character Updates:[/b]
[list][*] New Swapette Implemented - Bee Girl (temp name)
[*] Special Notes: once her special is activated, it will automatically break garbage rows, transforming them to regular blocks. It starts from the row closest to the board and goes up from there. Up to three garbage rows can be converted at once, and up to 1 garbage line can be converted from a cascade garbage block. 
[*] Yukimiko now has background art. [/list]

[b]UI/UX:[/b]
[list][*] Volume Slider now properly changes the volume more fluidly.
[*] Mute Button added to the sound options. 
[*] Story Mode now has a Retry Button if you lose against a Swapette. It will restart the chapter.
[*] Player 1 now controls the Main Menu.
[*] Player 2-4 cannot press back while player 1 controls the Main Menu.
[*] There is a back button on the character select screen, players must now hold down the back button to go back. [/list]

[b]Audio:[/b]
[list][*] Momoko now has a full track for her theme song. 
[*] Omelette has new special activiation SFX.
[*] Bee Girl’s theme and SFX sound were added.[/list]

[b]Discord Updates[/b]
[list][*] Our server was verified, giving us access to be benefits; like the banner and a custom invite link. 
[*] Our server was nitro boosted to level one, allowing us to have an animated server icon[/list]
